facts.fact: The IST-Africa paper (May 2022) says e-policing in Namibia records, stores and shares police information electronically, and that officers at Okahandja police station see storing the occurrence book electronically as duplication of data.
The paper says implementation is immature because not all units of the Namibian Police have been introduced to the system, and gives no count of stations.

systems.owner: Namibian Police Force, Ministry of Home Affairs, Immigration, Safety and Security
systems.tiers: Okahandja police station surveyed (60 officers); not all units introduced
